method: Compared explicit pq_rewards_skill/super_soul/equipment relationships in the canonical forward relationship layer against the source-normalized unified reverse index, including accessories under the canonical equipment relationship.

results.note: PQ1 and PQ47 have no explicit typed reward relationship in the canonical layer; the current normalized reverse index likewise provides no skill/Super Soul/equipment reward for those PQs. Their documented capsule/artwork/non-typed reward evidence is not converted into unsupported relationship types.

interpretation: The remaining 16-PQ skill-endpoint gap is not accompanied by a demonstrated missing Super Soul/equipment/accessory relationship in the current normalized evidence. The sole normalized-vs-forward discrepancy is the existing PQ48 Kamehameha/Kamekameha conflict.
actions_taken: No new canonical typed reward relationship was promoted because 32 of 33 normalized reward edges already exist in the canonical layer and the remaining edge is the known PQ48 skill conflict.
Preserved the canonical Kamehameha source endpoint at PQ5 rather than assigning PQ48 without direct item-level resolution.
next: Continue evidence work on the PQ48 Kamekameha label and independently audit other cross-domain gaps outside this 16-PQ subset.
